name: Langur Run
summary:
Welcome to Langur run! Run around and explore the maps in game! Or check out the other game modes like Nextbots horror!
Langur run is similar to Gorilla Tag, meaning you move with your hands. Make sure to check out the shop with multiple cosmetics you 
can put on to style your Langur! Or, if you are basic, just change your colors.
Langur Run is still brand new, so expect bugs. 

Have fun!
